summary_en: This phase 2 study tests golcadomide with rituximab as bridging treatment before CAR T-cell therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Golcadomide is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 14 of each cycle, and rituximab is given by vein on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of cycle 1 and then on day 1 of later cycles; the total duration is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa golcadomida con rituximab como tratamiento puente antes de la terapia con células T CAR en adultos con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B agresivo que recayó o no respondió al tratamiento previo. La golcadomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 14 de cada ciclo, y el rituximab se administra por vena en los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 del ciclo 1 y luego el día 1 de los ciclos siguientes; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Relapsed, progressive or refractory aggressive B-cell lymphoma after one or two prior lines of standard therapy
Measurable disease on PET-CT, with a lesion larger than 1.5 cm
Potentially eligible for CAR T-cell therapy as judged by the treating physician
not_for: Persons of childbearing potential not using adequate contraception
Prior CAR T or other T-cell targeting therapy within 4 weeks
